$comment: Derived from the pristine server HTML of every route (.recon/pages/*.html, fetched from https://jozue.fr) and the clone's React components (src/components, src/pages). EN and FR routes share identical structure (same class inventory), so each pair maps to one template. presentOn lists EN slugs; the FR route of each slug has the same blocks.

categories.SHELL: Persistent chrome present across routes: transition layer, menu toggle, menu overlay.
categories.RUNTIME: Utility/runtime UI that is not page content (preloader).
categories.WORKS: Portfolio index and navigation between projects.
categories.CASE: Body blocks of a work case study.
categories.ABOUT: Who the person is and what they do.

shell.page-transition-layer.description: Empty full-screen transition layer (#js-transi) with a title slot. It is in the DOM on every page but never animates: the real page transitions are swup-driven (a shared-element photo expansion from a work card to the work page, and a fade/slide back home).

shell.menu-toggle.description: Fixed three-bar burger button, top right. Its colour follows the section underneath (data-nav-dark) and it morphs into a close icon while the menu is open.
shell.menu-toggle.scope: Every route except the not-found page.

shell.menu-overlay.description: Full-screen dark menu panel that drops from the top. Three large links (About, Works, Contact) arrive with a staggered entrance, plus the EN/FR language switch.
shell.menu-overlay.scope: Every route except the not-found page.

runtime.intro-preloader.description: First-visit preloader: the handwritten 'J' signature is traced stroke by stroke, then a stage panel says hi and slides out. It has a skip button and is remembered in localStorage for a month, after which the page loads directly. Utility UI, not page content.
runtime.intro-preloader.scope: Both home routes (EN and FR) only.

hero.home-intro.description: Home opening screen. Contains in-page nav buttons (About / Works / Contact), the 'Hi, I am …' greeting, a giant rotating role title (three variants, letter-staggered), a two-slide bio slider, the address / phone / email column, a mouse-driven depth-parallax 'J' mark, and the red 'Explore my work' hint band.
hero.home-intro.scope: Both home routes (EN and FR) only.

works.selected-heading.description: Large 'selected works' title that opens the portfolio index.
works.selected-heading.scope: Both home routes (EN and FR) only.

works.filter-island.description: Floating pill-shaped filter bar (bottom centre) with cycling category words and a live work count. It opens into a clip-path panel of category filters; the chosen filter persists in sessionStorage. Includes a screen-reader live region announcing results.
works.filter-island.scope: Both home routes (EN and FR) only.

works.index-list.description: Full list of the 18 work cards: a giant title with category pastilles; on hover the card grows from 226 to 407px and reveals a zooming cover photo. Below 767px, half the cards hide behind a load-more button. Ends with the small 'Got a project?' prompt.
works.index-list.scope: Both home routes (EN and FR) only.

works.more-works.description: 'More works' heading followed by the cards of the other projects (same card design as the home index, without filtering), ending with the 'Got a project?' prompt.
works.more-works.scope: Every work page, editorial and app case studies alike.

cta.lets-talk.description: 'let's talk' band: large title, a freelance-availability line and a 'Get in touch' link to the contact block / mailto.
cta.lets-talk.scope: The home routes and every work page; not the not-found page.

cta.contact-footer.description: Closing contact screen: the full 'jozue' wordmark with soft parallax, social links (instagram, bluesky, linkedin), phone number and a large ink-roll mailto link.
cta.contact-footer.scope: Both home routes (EN and FR) only.

proof.awards.description: 'Awards & Archives' horizontal scroller of past projects. Each entry gives the project, client/agency, disciplines and award (FWA, Awwwards, CSSDA) and links out to the award page.
proof.awards.scope: Both home routes (EN and FR) only.

about.what-i-do.description: 'Few words about me' section: a looping marquee of disciplines (Graphic Design, Art Direction, Copywriting, Visual Identity, Digital Design, Photography, Filmmaking & more), the bio paragraph and the small 'J' mark.
about.what-i-do.scope: Both home routes (EN and FR) only.

proof.partners.description: 'Partners in crime' horizontal scroller of partner studios / freelancers: logo, role and outbound link. Logos lazy-load on approach.
proof.partners.scope: Both home routes (EN and FR) only.

hero.project-head.description: Work-page opening header: small 'jozue' logo, back link, meta columns (client, year, disciplines) and the project claim / slogan.

hero.project-cover.description: Full-bleed cover image of the project. It is the landing target of the card-to-page shared-element transition.

case.mission.description: Paragraph block with the project's mission / context statement. It can recur later in the page as an interstitial text block.

case.stills.description: Row of stills / photos (photography outtakes, frames) laid out as a horizontal strip.

case.gallery-3.description: Three-image gallery (or a duo variant) that opens in a lightbox.

case.block-title.description: Small bold uppercase heading that introduces the next body block (e.g. a large image or a reel).

case.image-large.description: Single full-width large image (key visual, poster, campaign shot).

case.quote-image.description: Quote or statement paired with an image, side by side.

case.carousel.description: Horizontal slider of media items. It includes click-to-play self-hosted videos (lazyframe items with a play button) and images.

case.reels.description: Vertical video reels (self-hosted mp4, preload none) with captions, for social-first films.

case.palette.description: Brand colour palette: swatches with their colour codes. On app case studies it sits inside the app frame.
case.palette.scope: Editorial case studies (also nested in the app frame of two app case studies).

case.triangle-composition.description: Bespoke triangle image composition (one oversized bleed image plus a triangle arrangement).

case.two-image-bleed.description: Two-image block where one image bleeds out of the grid.

case.external-link.description: Outbound link to the live project / campaign site.

case.app-frame.description: Browser/app window mockup (title bar with three bullets and a close control) that frames scrolling product screens. This is the signature block of the app/product case studies.

case.app-next.description: Next-screen control that advances the app-frame mockup to its next screen.

case.credits.description: 'Credits' small title followed by the credits list (roles → people / agencies).

status.not-found.description: Not-found message using the 'let's talk' band layout: giant 'not found' title, a one-line explanation and a 'Back home' link. An inline script swaps in the French copy for /fr/ paths.
status.not-found.scope: The not-found page only (served for any unknown URL).

templates.name: Work: editorial case study
templates.bodyFlow: The case.* blocks between hero.project-cover and case.credits are a per-project flow: each project uses its own subset, in its own order, and some blocks repeat (see each section's presentOn). The list above is a canonical ordering, not a fixed sequence.

templates.name: Work: app / product case study
templates.bodyFlow: Opens with the app-frame mockup and its next-screen control; then a per-project subset of the shared case.* blocks. fnac-darty has only the frame, the next control and credits.
